releaseName: ADC Software 8.5 Standard · Subscription Pricing & Release Notes
releaseNotes: Pricing update: ADC 8.5 Pro subscription preview offers 1 month for PKR 9,999 and 3 months for PKR 24,999.
Improved: Selecting a subscription plan immediately updates the displayed price and payment summary.
Bug fix: Copied payment instructions now use the exact price of the selected subscription plan.
Improved: Software Updates now shows concise, customer-facing release notes.
